senses.gloss: (b. h.; √או, v. אוי II; cmp. חָוַר, חָבַר, a. sec. r. אָרַר)to perforate, break through, shine.—Denom. אַוִּיר, מְאוּרָה &c.
to be broken through, grow light. Y. Ber. I, 2ᶜ משיֵאוֹר המזרח from the time the Eastern horizon is broken through, grows light.
(neut. v.) to break through, shine. Y. ib. III, 6ᶜ bot. open thy lips ויָאִירוּ דבריך and let thy words come forth, speak out boldly.
units: Yoma III, 1 ה׳ פני כל וכ׳ it has grown light all over the Eastern horizon.—פנים מֵאִירוֹת bright countenance.
